title: IELTS Academic 21 - Test 3 - Passage 3: Rethinking the Past
passageHtml:
READING PASSAGE 3

Rethinking the Past

It is by now a truism that the story of human evolution is being rethought...

However, I do think it's possible to draw out some overall messages from the blizzard of archaeological finds in recent years...

At Kalambo Falls in Zambia, researchers found buried logs that had been shaped with stone tools so that they interlocked... 476,000 years old. Almost 200,000 years before our species evolved. Denisovans lived on the frozen heights of high-altitude regions 200,000 years ago...

evidence for a long time now that Neanderthals painted on cave walls. Even earlier species, such as Homo erectus, may also have made art, for example by engraving patterns on shells. ... in Rising Star cave... etchings... yet to be firmly dated.

The dispute has only been heightened by the way the results were released... At the same time, I think the species' small brains are a distraction.

Evolution usually works by incremental steps and so does technology. The first birds weren't great at flying, and the first mobile phones weren't great at, well, anything really.

Archaeology was invented by individuals with now unfashionably patriarchal views about gender... Today's researchers are trying to unpick this stuff...

However, a meta-analysis published in June 2023 compiled data on several dozen foraging societies and found women hunted in 80 per cent of them. Going further back, an Iberian leader from around 4000 years ago turned out to be female, not male as many had assumed...

Inequality, authoritarianism and patriarchy aren't inevitable. They're choices, and prehistory shows us that we can choose differently.

Questions 27-30

27. Writer doing in second paragraph: A. pinpointing some key changes in understanding

Questions 31-34

31. Kalambo Falls: E. Homo sapiens probably not only species capable of sophisticated workmanship

Đáp án: E

Đáp án: F

33. June 2023 publication: D. mistaken about who looked for food

Đáp án: D

34. Iberian leader: B. previous assumptions about who had power were inaccurate

Đáp án: B
